description: Stadt Zehdenick - Regenwasser Schächte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by stadtwerke-zehdenick.de. Contains information on the shafts of the rainwater network of the Zehdenick City Drainage Plant. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Zehdenick - Rainwater shafts" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include land use, opendata. The listing shows 2013-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
